It is also the shape .gitattributes' own audit-log block already refused in this repo: "DO NOT fix this by normalizing line endings inside the comparator: that blinds a tamper detector to a real whole-file rewrite in order to silence a checkout artifact." `binary` (= -text -diff -merge) rather than `-text` alone: -text stops the eol conversion, the whole measured defect, but leaves the default TEXT MERGE armed on tokenizer.json, and a clean auto-merge of a hash-pinned asset yields bytes matching neither parent and breaks the pin with NO conflict. The consequence is forward-looking rather than present -- the next NUL-free member added there (a second *.json, a merges.txt, a vocab.txt) is the uncovered one -- which is why the entry is written `/**` over the directory.
